_comment_: Example run config. Copy to runs/<month>-<card>.json and edit. Paths resolve relative to THIS file's directory.

statement._: REQUIRED block. One credit card per run (multi-card support is BLUEPRINT B3).
statement._path_help: .csv or .xlsx (or .xlsm). Filename relative to this config file.
statement._account_id_help: Free-form identifier for this card. Drives the per-card tab name in the report.
statement._legal_entity_id_help: Brisken entity that owns this card. Free-form for slice 1.
statement._account_card_currency_help: Currency of the card itself (v2 spec layer 2). Used as the default transaction currency when no per-row currency column is mapped.
statement._column_map_help: Logical field -> source CSV/Excel column header. Required keys: transaction_date, amount, vendor. Optional: posting_date, transaction_currency.
statement._sheet_name_help: Optional. Only used for .xlsx multi-sheet workbooks. Defaults to the active sheet.

receipts._: REQUIRED block. Slice 1: receipts come from a CSV of already-extracted fields. Slice 2 replaces this with a folder of receipt images + Claude vision OCR.
receipts._default_currency_help: Optional. Applied to receipt rows that have no detected_currency value.

output._: OPTIONAL block. If absent, default report.xlsx is written next to this config. --out CLI flag overrides this.
